content: बुद्धिः {%f.%} [बुध्-क्तिन्] .²1 Perception, comprehension. .²2 Intellect, understanding, intelligence, talent; तीक्ष्णा नारुंतुदा बुद्धिः <ls>Śi. 2. 109</ls>; शास्त्रेष्वकुण्ठिता बुद्धिः <ls>R. 1. 19</ls>. .²3 Information, knowledge; बुद्धिर्यस्य बलं तस्य <ls>H. 2. 122</ls> ‘knowledge is power’; <ls>P. I. 4. 52</ls>. .²4 Discrimination, judgment, discernment; विदेशेष्वपि विज्ञाताः सर्वतो बुद्धिनिश्चयाः <ls>Rām. 1. 7. 17</ls>. .²5 Mind; मूढः परप्रत्ययनेयबुद्धिः <ls>M. 1. 2</ls>; so कृपण˚, पाप˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 Presence of mind, readiness of wit. .²7 An impression, opinion, belief, idea, feeling; दूरात्तमवलोक्य व्याघ्रबुद्धया पलायन्ते <ls>H. 3</ls>; अनया बुद्धया <ls>Mu. 1</ls> ‘in this belief’; अनुक्रोशबुद्धपा <ls>Me. 117</ls>. .²8 Intention, purpose, design; मन्दीचकार मरणव्यवसायबुद्धिम् <ls>Ku. 4. 45</ls>. (बुद्ध्या ‘intentionally’, ‘purposely’, ‘deliberately’). .²9 Returning to consciousness, recovery from a swoon; <ls>Māl. 4. 10</ls>. .²10 (In <ab>Sāṅ. phil.</ab>) Intellect, the second of the 25 elements of the Sāṅkhyas; एषा तेऽभिहिता सांख्ये बुद्धिर्योगे त्विमां शृणु <ls>Bg. 2. 39</ls>. .²11 Nature (प्रकृति); <ls>Bhāg. 3. 27. 18</ls>. .²12 A means, way (उपाय); किं करिष्याम भद्रं ते बुद्धिरत्र विचार्यताम् <ls>Rām. 1. 40. 9</ls>. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of the 5th astrological mansion.
